parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This part consists of one blade and its attached handle, made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism and provides one of the gripping handles for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot to perform the cutting motion.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This part includes the second blade and its handle, made of stainless steel and plastic respectively.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the other half of the cutting pair and provides the second handle for gripping and control.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw to open and close against the other blade, enabling cutting.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade-handle sets at their pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two blades together and allows them to rotate smoothly around the pivot.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place while allowing rotational movement of the blades around it.
